sources.t: Ofcom proposes to block new Openreach commercial offer to protect fair competition and keep long-term prices low
sources.f: Published 28 July 2026; Ofcom provisionally proposed directing Openreach to withdraw one notified full-fibre customer offer, with responses due 27 August 2026 and a final decision expected by the end of September.
sources.g: A provisional wholesale-pricing intervention concerns competition and does not establish live or orderable service at an address or parcel.

sources.f: Last updated 28 July 2026; the review covers fixed-telecoms regulation for April 2026 to March 2031 and links the July Openreach commercial-offers consultation.
sources.g: A regulatory framework and market review do not prove deployment or current premises orderability.

sources.t: Call for Inputs: Openreach’s proposed commercial offers
sources.f: Published 2 June 2026 and updated 28 July 2026; Ofcom sought initial views on pricing offers notified by Openreach and recorded the matter as pending statement.
sources.g: A call for inputs and notified pricing offers are market evidence, not exact-location service evidence.

sources.t: Electronic Communications Code: Consultations and Final Directions
sources.f: Last updated 27 July 2026; the page indexes consultation documents and final directions issued under the Communications Act 2003 for Code powers.
sources.g: An index of legal powers and directions does not show that infrastructure has been built, activated or made orderable at a parcel.

sources.f: Last updated 23 July 2026; Ofcom reported Q1 2026 aggregated UK telecoms market trends, including 29.4 million fixed broadband lines and 90.6 million active mobile subscriptions excluding M2M.
sources.g: National quarterly market totals cannot establish provider availability or service at an individual address.

sources.t: Investigation into Pine Media compliance with Funds for Meeting Liabilities requirements
sources.f: Opened 16 July 2026; Ofcom is examining Pine Media's compliance with Regulation 16 financial-instrument requirements for Code Operators.
sources.g: An open financial-compliance investigation does not prove network deployment, coverage or premises service.

sources.t: Investigation into Trooli compliance with Funds for Meeting Liabilities requirements
sources.f: Opened 16 July 2026; Ofcom records investigations concerning Trooli Ltd and Trooli Thistle Limited under Regulation 16.
sources.g: Provider-level regulatory compliance evidence is not current exact-location connectivity evidence.

sources.t: Investigation into Cambridge Fibre Networks compliance with Funds for Meeting Liabilities requirements
sources.f: Opened 16 July 2026; Ofcom is examining Cambridge Fibre Networks' compliance with Regulation 16 financial assurance duties.
sources.g: An investigation into Code-operator liabilities does not establish built network routes or orderability.
